decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s proven camera business with visible market presentation, it is likely judged against tolerable early aspirations and supported by enough organisational slack to remain on the market.

A modular product line with several models fits the firm’s established capabilities especially well, so management would likely see sufficient strategic promise and keep it unless performance clearly falls below aspirations.

Because it builds on the existing sensor portfolio and serves an adjacent space need, the firm would likely continue it while learning from initial market feedback rather than redeploying resources immediately.

Although technologically aligned with the firm’s competences, its weaker website presence and higher novelty make it somewhat more vulnerable, but a large R&D-intensive space supplier would still likely retain it for further qualification and search.
